muc.title: Correct grammar, still hard to understand
muc.text: You speak English with correct grammar but people still don't understand. It's usually pronunciation and intonation.

muc.title: Turn on voice mode
muc.text: Turn on voice mode, read a short passage, and ask AI to repeat the words it couldn't hear clearly.

muc.title: Stress and rising tone
muc.text: Ask AI to mark the stressed syllables and where your voice should rise, then repeat after its sample voice.

muc.title: AI is a generous listener
muc.text: The limit: AI often guesses what you meant even when you mispronounce it, so don't trust it as a strict grader.

muc.title: Read your introduction
muc.text: Turn on voice in a chatbot, read your self-introduction, and ask it to point out two words to fix.
